description: Compares a voltage against a threshold and puts out gates saying which side of it the voltage is on

params.text: Sets the threshold, -10V to +10V; any voltage at the threshold CV input is added to it

inputs.text: Shifts the threshold, added to the THRESHOLD knob volt for volt
The voltage compared against the threshold

outputs.text: 10V while the input is above the threshold, 0V otherwise
10V while the input is at or below the threshold, 0V otherwise

notes: the comparison is monophonic; only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is compared
